codeReview.summary: The fix addresses the prior blocking cleanup gap. In `src/parser/evtx/worker.zig`, worker startup now routes through `startWorkerTask`, which cancels and joins a newly spawned thread if `active.append` fails, while `parseConcurrentWithSink` now has an `errdefer` cleanup path that cancels and joins every already-active worker before returning any startup error. I also reviewed the earlier `ab31d99` Bugbot fix diff and did not find this follow-up regressing the previously landed ordered/unordered cleanup, sink-failure handling, or verbosity behavior.
